main_text.p: Et Psalmo 76. qui insignem gratiarum actio-nem continet, ob id quòd Dominus suam Ec-clefiam sartā tectam præstiterit, maximè verò quòd admirabilem suam potentiam aduersus tam validos & omnibus armis instructissimos hostes explicuerit, in hæc verba erùpit Dauid,

page.notes: Catchword "Non" at lower right. Long s rendered as s; some ligatures and s forms normalised. Some words uncertain in the italic verse (e.g. "Preda", "dextera") given as printed.
